verdict.rationale: Box provides the core building blocks for a lightweight data room: shared links with view-only/download restrictions (box-docs-3, box-docs-20, box-docs-24), folder-level collaborations with granular role-based access for external parties (box-docs-4, box-docs-21), webhook/event tracking for access visibility (box-docs-7, box-docs-8, box-docs-19, box-docs-22), and community confirmation that selectively granting outside parties folder access works well in practice (box-comm-9). Secure expiring previews with annotation further support diligence workflows (box-docs-14). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'data room' template or granular per-link download-disable toggle, and no independent/hands-on validation of access-visibility dashboards specifically for diligence use cases.
